deadline.value: Recommended deadline for Fall graduate assistantship consideration is February 1.
deadline.quote: The recommended deadline for fall semester graduate assistantship consideration is Feb. 1, although departments/programs may have earlier deadlines.

gre_general.value: GRE is required; waiver is available only for students with an ABET-accredited B.S. degree and high GPA.
gre_general.quote: Students who are applying for the Ph.D. E.E. degree may have the GRE requirement waived providing the student obtained a B.S. degree from an ABET-Accredited program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the catalog page.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships include a monthly stipend and tuition coverage, awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Graduate Assistant Positions: All graduate assistants receive a monthly stipend, and | most cover the cost of tuition.

entry_route.value: Students may enter with a bachelor's degree (36 hours coursework) or with an M.S. degree (minimum additional 12 hours graded coursework).
entry_route.quote: A student entering the Ph.D. program with an M.S. degree will be required to complete a minimum of an additional 12 hours of graded coursework
